dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with zero curvature; straight diagonal pixel path from apex to posterior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with minimal pixel radius; single-pixel convergence point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 50-degree incline relative to the longitudinal horizontal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-convexity faceted arc composed of discrete linear segments; wide effective pixel radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick aspect; length from inflection to tip is approximately 1.5 times the base thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse inflection point where the forehead facet transitions to the rostrum facet.

other_distinctive_markers: The subject is a low-polygon 3D mesh with a uniform cyan-emissive luminescent shader.
